name: WNBA_R1A4B1_PRODUCTION_FALLBACK_ASOF_ANALOGUE_V1
why_distinct: The preferred BALLDONTLIE advanced source cannot be certified in GitHub Actions because BDL_API_KEY is absent. This analogue therefore does not claim exact SPORTS_ONLY_V1 preferred-source replay; it freezes the already-deployed production fallback path as a separate historical candidate before any 2021-2025 target outcome is opened.

frozen_formula.source_semantics: Exact fallback expressions already present in server/wnba-independent-routes.ts; historical reconstruction uses per-game means over prior finalized regular-season games only.
frozen_formula.quantization: round pace/offRtg/defRtg/netRtg to one decimal before model consumption
frozen_formula.recent_aliases: recentPace=pace, recentOffRtg=offRtg, recentDefRtg=defRtg, recentNetRtg=netRtg, preserving frozen deployed alias semantics

historical_constructor_rules.eligible_games: Regular-season games finalized strictly before target pregame cutoff.
historical_constructor_rules.target_exclusion: Exclude target game_id before reading any score/stat value.
historical_constructor_rules.future_exclusion: Exclude every game whose final state was not knowable before target cutoff.
historical_constructor_rules.aggregation: Unweighted per-game arithmetic means, matching the per-game interpretation required by the deployed fallback expression.
historical_constructor_rules.overtime: Use full-game final traditional boxscore values; no regulation-only normalization.
historical_constructor_rules.zero_or_missing_prior_games: COLD_START_UNAVAILABLE; do not impute future/current/final-season values.

validation_2026.name: team_season_stats_2026.parquet
validation_2026.purpose: Validate the deployed fallback expression on an out-of-cohort season and quantify, descriptively only, its distance from official advanced ratings.
validation_2026.basic_snapshot_reconstruction_gate: The selected regular-season/per-game row must produce finite fallback pace/offRtg. At least 10 teams required.
validation_2026.advanced_distance_policy: Descriptive only. No closeness threshold is used to select or alter the analogue; the formula is already frozen because it is the deployed production fallback.

anti_leakage_rules: No 2021-2025 score, winner, linescore or target-derived statistic value may be loaded in R1A.4B1.
Historical Parquet schema metadata may be inspected to prove required columns exist.
2026 is outside the target evaluation cohort and may be used only for source/semantic characterization.
The 2026 comparison cannot change the frozen formula, quantization, minimum-prior-game rule, season type or missingness rule.
No injury/manual state is inferred or zero-filled by this gate.
